message:
You know, after all these years of feeling like a deer in the headlights when storms roll through, I finally decided to get my act together. I stumbled upon a fantastic resource that lays out all the essentials for tornado preparedness. It’s a bit like finding the user manual for a gadget you thought you’d never figure out. 

Now I feel like I might actually be the prepared one when the winds kick up. Who knew that a little planning could bring such peace of mind? What’s your go-to tip for staying ready during storm season?
